text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. What are the types of seats available?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Regular and Recliner (in future, we can have PREMIUM, VIP etc)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. What payment methods are support in our system?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - UPI and CARD payment methods, but we should be able to add more in future.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. We can add theatre in our system.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. We can add screen in the theatre.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. We can add seat in the screen.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. We can add movie in the system.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5. we can create shows in the system.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 6. Users should be able to search movie by name and get all the shows for that movie.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. Should we make the system thread safe?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Yes, if two users try booking the same seats concurrently, only one should succeed

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. Should failed payments or expired locks free the seat for others to book immediately?
